crew.overview: A kindhearted street urchin named Aladdin embarks on a magical adventure after finding a lamp that releases a wisecracking genie while a power-hungry Grand Vizier vies for the same lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.
crew.title: Aladdin

crew.original_title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
crew.overview: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.
crew.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

details.biography:
Pietro Ponti is a Visual Effects Supervisor at Industrial Light & Magic, where he has been contributing since 2021, bringing with him over 15 years of industry experience. Before joining ILM, Ponti served as VFX Supervisor and Head of VFX at Important Looking Pirates, where he led visual effects efforts on major studio features such as Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, Disney’s Aladdin (live-action), and Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. His work also extended to high-profile episodic productions, including HBO’s Lovecraft Country.

In addition to his creative leadership, Ponti played a key role in expanding ILP’s production infrastructure and workflows. He is widely recognised for his ability to guide complex projects involving expansive environments, sophisticated FX work, and large shot volumes, consistently embracing technical and creative challenges.

Earlier in his career at Double Negative, Ponti contributed to blockbuster franchises such as Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, the Harry Potter series, and Marvel’s Thor: The Dark World. There, he was also deeply involved in mentoring junior artists and supporting their development through on-show training.

Ponti’s excellence has been acknowledged by the Visual Effects Society with two nominations for his work on Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2, specifically for Outstanding Model and Outstanding Created Environment for the Hogwarts Castle sequence, where he served as Sequence Supervisor.
details.name: Pietro Ponti
